_note: Written by hand: the answers a careful reader would give for the three invented themes of test_s3_pain_points.py. The test fills in `quotes` and `glosses`, which depend on the sample that was sent.

payment.label: Payments fail after money is debited
payment.description: A payment shows as failed although the money has left the user's bank account.
payment.severity_reason: Users lose money and cannot settle up, which is the product's main task.

login.label: Login code never arrives
login.description: Users cannot log in because the verification code is not delivered.
login.severity_reason: A user who cannot log in cannot use the product, but nothing is lost.

ads.label: Too many full-screen ads
ads.description: Full-screen ads interrupt users after almost every tap.
ads.severity_reason: The product still works; the ads are an annoyance.

junk.junk_reason: The reviews share no single complaint.
